title: Shipping Terms
summary: Orders usually take 1–2 business days to be dispatched, and delivery within Australia can take up to 14 working days once an order leaves the warehouse. All orders are tracked.
bodyHtml:
Shipping
Ideally, we want our Shipping to be as fast as possible, but it might take 1 - 2 business days before your package can be en route to your location.

Due to the nature of having our stock located across several warehouses around Australia and sometimes the world, deliveries on all orders can vary based on warehouse and supplier stock levels. We appreciate that this can take some time to arrive however in order to give you peace of mind, the OzLED team provide tracking on all orders. Should you have any questions about this please don't hesitate to reach out and chat to us at sales@ozled.com.au

Shipping Costs
Whilst every attempt to ensure the shipping calculator on our website is correct, OzLED retains the right to contact any customer if the items ordered exceed the standard shipping weights that can be calculated online or in relation to any shipping costs outside a reasonable figure. OzLED retains the right to cancel any order if contact can not be made. This is generally the case with larger products (ie Lightbars, Arrow Boards and some other assorted products). You will be contacted by the OzLED team at the first available chance to discuss alternate delivery costs and arrangements after purchase if this applies to your order.

Time Frame
From the moment deliveries have been fulfilled within our warehouses, the delivery within Australia can take up to 14 Working Days. In the rare occurrence that your orders take longer than 14 working days or more from the day you ordered them please contact us to locate your items.

We're committed to providing you the best experience, However, please contact us first in order to give you an ETA on your parcels. Any delivery times longer than what's mentioned above occur in less than 1% of orders as we place a major emphasis on ensuring that you get the fastest order processing possible.

Lost Shipments
While very rare, occasionally courier services can lose or misplace packages. In the case that you believe this has happened please contact the sales team to investigate with the selected courier. It's important to note that should the courier company provide proof of delivery in line with their services, OzLED cannot be held responsible for the delivery and will not provide any replacement items.

Incorrect Ship To Addresses, Ordering Incorrect Items, And Requesting Changes To Existing Orders

  • The customer is responsible for making sure their order is accurate (shipping address, shipping method, and items ordered including sizes, vehicle fitments and compatibility, colours and quantities). We will attempt to correct your mistake if we can but it is not always practical.
  • If possible, we can attempt to change the shipping to address once the package has been shipped, however, we are completely subject to the shipping company’s policies. If the address can be changed, a $10 service charge may apply.
  • We will not be responsible for errors made by customers entering or providing incorrect information. We will not reship the order for free, nor pay for the incorrect items to be shipped back to us. Items needing to be returned are subject to our Return Policy.

seo.title: Shipping Terms | OzLED
seo.description: OzLED shipping terms: dispatch in 1–2 business days, delivery within Australia in up to 14 working days, tracking on all orders, and oversize freight.

title: Free Shipping Conditions
summary: Free shipping applies when the product subtotal exceeds $99 including GST, for retail and member customers, to Australian addresses only. Trade accounts don't include free shipping.
bodyHtml:
Eligibility
In an ideal world, we would want to offer everyone free shipping. However, as freight costs increase we must set in stone the following eligibility requirements to warrant free shipping on your order.

1. The product subtotal of your order must exceed $99.00 AUD. This is inclusive of GST.
2. Retail & Member Customers only.
3. Free Shipping is strictly available for Australian Addresses only, not available for International Orders.

Delivery Time
From the moment deliveries have been fulfilled within our warehouses, the delivery within Australia can take up to 14 Working Days. In the rare occurrence that your orders take longer than 14 working days or more from the day you ordered them please contact us to locate your items.

We're committed to providing you with the best experience, However, please contact us first in order to give you an ETA on your parcels. Any delivery times longer than what's mentioned above occur in less than 1% of orders as we place a major emphasis on ensuring that you get the fastest order processing possible.

Trade Customers
We offer our trade customers our absolute best price possible however, trade pricing does not factor in the cost of freight like retail and member pricing does. When purchasing under a trade account you will notice you do not have access to the Free Shipping option. This is a benefit as you actually save a great deal extra as you are no longer paying for freight priced into each product. As a trade customer, you can leverage your discounts with access to our best possible freight pricing available.

seo.title: Free Shipping Conditions | OzLED
seo.description: OzLED free shipping applies to retail and member orders over $99 (inc GST) delivered to Australian addresses. Trade pricing excludes freight. Full conditions.

title: Warranty and Returns Policy
summary: Exchanges and refunds can be made in store within 14 days of purchase. Faulty products must be returned to OzLED in Brendale for a warranty assessment, and a tax invoice is required for all returns.
bodyHtml:
RETURNS POLICY FOR PRODUCTS PURCHASED ONLINE OR INSTORE

Exchanges and refunds on OzLED products may be made in-store within 14 days from your date of purchase.

Exchanges, Warranty Assessments and Returns for all OzLED products must be done at our physical location listed below. To exchange an OzLED product visit us in our Brendale store or return via post.

OzLED Online Returns
U1/218 Leitchs Road
Brendale QLD 4500
Australia

WARRANTY ASSESSMENTS & RETURNS

If you believe that your product is faulty and eligible for a warranty, You must return the goods to OzLED for assessment. OzLED will not supply any goods until a Warranty Assessment is completed and approved. OzLED will dispatch no goods under “good will” or without payment attached.

What if I can’t go without the product?

  • If you are in the position where you still require the product (Such as a LED Tail Light where removing the light will mean you can't drive the vehicle). You have the option of purchasing a replacement unit and then returning the faulty product for assessment. Should the returned product be approved under warranty we will only then refund the cost of the replacement unit.

IMPORTANT NOTES

OzLED will only accept product returns under the following circumstances:

  • If the product is faulty and needs assessment.
  • A customer would like to exchange their product for another.
  • Or, when approved by an OzLED Team Member.

OzLED reserves the right to assess the condition and age of all returned products.

  • This may result in the products not being accepted for return, repair, refund, credit note or exchange.
  • Where possible products must be in the new and original condition as purchased, with all labels/tickets attached. (Not applicable for warranty assessments).
  • Tax Invoices must be provided as proof of purchase for all returns, no exceptions.
  • Please choose carefully as we do not refund, exchange or give store credit if you simply change your mind or misunderstand a product listing unless they are faulty, wrongly described or do not do what they are supposed to do.

If one product is returned that was part of a '2 for' or “multiple product sale” or any other online special deal, the product will be credited at the discounted price or at the percentage price as calculated by OzLED which was paid and not the full price.

Please note customers are responsible for any and all costs of postage for all returns, with the exception of faulty products. If your product is faulty, please contact our Customer Care team to arrange a return in this instance.

seo.title: Warranty and Returns Policy | OzLED
seo.description: How OzLED handles exchanges, refunds and warranty assessments: 14-day in-store exchanges, returns to our Brendale store, and tax invoices required.

title: Restricted Item Policy
summary: Red or blue flashing lights, emergency siren drivers and similar items are restricted. OzLED requires a completed Restricted Item Statement before releasing any restricted item.
bodyHtml:
Restricted Items:

A restricted colour item includes but is not limited to the following;

  • Red or Blue flashing LED lights.
  • Siren Drivers capable of producing Emergency Vehicle Siren outputs.
  • Any other item that would be reasonably seen as being illegal for the average road user to mount to their vehicle.
  • Any other item or product deemed to be restricted by any OzLED representative for any reason.

Restricted Item Order Process:

  • Restricted items on our website require your agreement to these terms when adding to cart.
  • At the time of purchase you are/were aware the product was a restricted item and that a Restricted Item Statement will be required before the release of goods.
  • You have viewed the product in person or online and accept the sizing, colour, light output etc.

Release of Restricted Items:

  • You agree that before OzLED will release ANY Restricted Item, you must provide OzLED a filled out copy of the Restricted Item Statement. DOWNLOAD HERE
  • You agree that Restricted Item orders may take longer to process due to the additional paperwork requirements
  • You agree that all customer information will be kept on record including Names, Address, Contact information and Signatures.
  • You agree that any misuse of Restricted Items may result in criminal charges or legal action.
  • You agree that OzLED and all of its representatives are not and cannot be held responsible for any use of Restricted Items.

seo.title: Restricted Item Policy | OzLED
seo.description: OzLED's restricted item policy covers red and blue flashing lights and emergency sirens. A signed Restricted Item Statement is required before release.

title: About Us
summary: OzLED was established in 1979 as Multisound Enterprises to supply emergency lighting and sirens, changed its name to OzLED Pty Ltd in 2005 and launched its own brand, BASE6, in 2013.
bodyHtml:
OzLED is a recognized leader in the LED lighting business in Australia, we pride ourselves on providing only quality products to our valued customers.

proudly 100% Australian owned and operated.

OZLED WAS ESTABLISHED IN 1979 AS MULTISOUND ENTERPRISES IN RESPONSE TO A GROWING NEED WITHIN AUSTRALIA FOR SPECIALIZED EMERGENCY LIGHTING AND SIRENS.

As Australia’s local and international markets and its economy have flourished, so has demand for high-level services across all sectors of the country’s infrastructure. In the constantly changing emergency services industry, OzLED has built a reputation for being reliably responsive and pro-active, understanding the often complex needs and expectations of Emergency services and related industries. Over the years the company has shown an exceptional pattern of growth in key areas throughout the country. It has a proud record of success in a challenging market. The constant acceptance of new technology triggered the name change in 2005 to OzLED Pty Ltd.

2013 saw the launch of our own brand “Base6”, an extensive range of quality LED lighting for every industry and every application. Developed incorporating years of research and hands on experience selling and fitting LED lighting, Base6 was the logical progression for our continually expanding company and a way to provide better quality lighting for ourselves and our customers.

OzLED is a recognized leader in the LED lighting business in Australia. There are some notable factors which contribute to this position of leadership.

  • Astute, hands-on management and highly trained technical workforce
  • Unsurpassed understanding of local markets & exceptional knowledge of products and applications.
  • Extensive range of quality products both local and international
  • Electronic catalogue , available to customers
  • Outstanding customer support providing technical product knowledge, news bulletins.
